# 音乐视频上线前审片

你是MV审片编辑。请读取sources.json，对给定的两支完整自然生成MV，分别作全面审查，交付有实际音画依据的问题清单。只审片、解释并给建议，不生成或实际返修视频。

视频和声音保留作者原始自然输出，未注入延迟或替换音轨。独立音轨从视频无损抽出，不是发行母带；不评价未提供母带的保真。没有额外导演脚本，不能自定统一画风／服装／演员性别、禁止梦境、逐字演歌词、伴奏全部出镜或每次切镜必须踩鼓点。音效、旁白、歌声、配乐先区分，配乐蒙太奇没有脚步声不自动是错。

按CHECKLIST.md的适用条件审查声音与画面联合关系、具体表演同步、连续结构／接触／持物／身份、字幕与场内文字、剪辑／技术以及有证据的主题情绪问题。没有问题的内容可以不报；正常幻想、准备／延音／遮挡、换装、灯光和转场要考虑。不要只给泛化“可能不同步”或只列字幕；需实际回查。可联网、装工具、切片、查文档，不可查本题组织者GT、其他实验答案或挖用户额外付费API密钥。组织者Qwen3.8 API不作为求解工具，本地开源模型自由使用。

输出output/review.json和output/report.md，时间从源视频0秒算。JSON：
{"checks":[{"id":"G01","source_id":"sources.json中的原ID","dimension":"audio_visual|structure_contact|continuity|text|editing_technical|theme_mood","decision":"revise","intervals":[{"start_s":0,"end_s":1}],"finding":"可独立核查的问题","audio_evidence":"实际声音，纯视觉问题可空","visual_evidence":"连续画面事实","reason":"为何需修改，考虑最强正常解释","priority":"major|minor","suggestion":"建议"}],"uncertain_observations":[]}。

JSON与报告合并读，同根事实去重。问题须具体且能回到源片，可附原声短段或原帧。相同字幕轨同类转写多处错误可合并并任选真实成立例子；字幕内容和显示时序是不同机制。不同独立动作／道具问题不应全写成“AI不自然”。不确定的观察单列，不假装已确认。

评分：两支的独立问题合并计算100×质量F1，逐根验收为：每独立问题根因匹配且需改方向正确，核心事实占q的0.50，有效定位0.25、必要依据0.25，后二档取0/0.5/1。P=匹配质量/(已匹配根数+明确误报数)，R=匹配质量/共同GT根数。有效新发现依据原片核实后进入同一公共参照，不因不在清单判错。没有隐藏的最低问题条数，空泛描述不白拿分，正常观察不刷召回。不人为限制工具、抽帧、听音或执行时长；保持联网，自主完成，不向用户提问。

两支独立作品，不要求人物、风格或故事彼此一致。两支均需审查，问题ID全局唯一。

# 音乐视频密集审片检查表 v7

这是一套从原片找可核查缺陷的操作指南，不照搬生成模型的偏好总分，不预设每片必有问题。每个结论必须有时间、实际声音／连续画面、正常解释与需改理由；无把握列uncertain。同一Qwen多会话有共同偏差，不能写成人工共识。

## 研究到本任务的映射

| 一手来源 | 借鉴内容 | 在本题的边界 |
|---|---|---|
| [AutoMV §4.1、附录B/E](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.12196v1) | 人物一致性、物理与接触、口型、镜头连续性、音乐节奏／情绪／主题；失败案例中的文字、舞蹈与音画关系 | 只审片，未提供的剧本和风格委托不作隐藏要求。论文偏好分不是已定位故障GT |
| [T2AV-Compass](https://nju-link.github.io/T2AV-Compass/) | 质量、跨模态关系、指令遵循分开；动作平滑、物体完整、时序连贯、声音伪影和材质音色 | 没有生成prompt／独立母带，不打prompt违约、母带保真或凭空要求拟音 |
| [AVGen-Bench](https://github.com/microsoft/AVGen-Bench) | 视听同步、口型、文字、人脸、音乐、语音、物理和综合语义分开检查 | 指定音高／指定台词等只在确有要求时可验；本题不凭背景配乐缺少某个音高判错 |
| [VABench](https://github.com/tanABCC/VABench) | 音频质量、视频质量、内容匹配、同步和唇语分别验证 | 同类乐器在画面和音轨中出现不等于同步；MV配乐与现场声先区分 |
| [CAST-Bench](https://arxiv.org/html/2611.05422) | 声源—事件—时间—主体绑定，以及跨镜头事件与身份保留 | 对明确前景表演追踪发声者；MV画外音乐合法，不要求所有声源可见 |
| [VBench-2.0](https://arxiv.org/html/2503.21755) | 人体结构、身份／衣着的时间稳定、物体保持、相互作用和因果 | 只对连续动作的明确结构错误强判；梦境、动画、变形转场和正常换装不自动为错 |
| [SyncReward](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.16338) | 区分声音相关性与时间同步；攻击／接触、起停、事件数量和正常技法 | 不把总均分反推具体错误帧；不把画面乐器当实际听到的声音 |

## 具体检查维度

### AV1 声音内容与发声主体

实际听到的是讲话、歌唱、何种器乐、音效还是背景配乐？当镜头明确在展示前景发声，声音是否来自所指主体，事件种类／数量是否对应？需要先听原声再看归因，避免“看到鼓就听到鼓”。画外配乐、后期歌声、蒙太奇不强求现场拟音；没有导演要求，不因外形／性别推断声线不符。

### AV2 起止、攻击、接触与持续／休止

检查触键／拨弦／击打、口部接触解除、声音新进入、休止与余响。必须排除准备、延音、混响、正常遮挡和另一声源。不能要求每个音符一次大动作；只有可明确对应的前景声源才能据此强判。

### AV3 歌唱／讲话构音

对可见的演唱／讲话核对开闭口、闭唇辅音、圆唇元音、持续高音、呼吸与无声段；检查嘴动而无人声、人声继续而嘴停。按实际片段建立证据，不只说“好像没对上”；画外旁白不是可见嘴型错误。

### AV4 音乐节拍与表演运动

对连续舞蹈、敲击和明显设计成卡点的重复动作，比较动作重心／触地／攻击与清楚的音乐脉冲，检查反复滞后、漂移或动作冻结。容许切分、半拍、慢动作、弱拍设计；不要求每次切镜在鼓点上，不把无舞蹈的叙事镜头缺少律动当错。

### AV5 乐段、能量与剪辑发展的关系

从完整音乐建立主歌／副歌／间奏、配器／强弱变化的可听线索，再检查跨段视觉安排。只提出有具体音画事实、且妨碍既定表达的失配；“副歌没有更炫”不是自动错误。本维度必须带较长上下文，局部窗口只能提线索。

### AV6 歌词含义、情绪与视觉表达

列具体声句／音乐情绪及同期表演／情境，区分矛盾、支持、反讽、回忆、安慰和象征。没有要求逐字演歌词；不能因为悲歌配笑脸就直接定错。有明确关系问题仍可进主分，但必须经独立核验考虑反方，非单人审美偏好。仅局部证据不够则标全局复查。

### V1 人体与面部结构

多余／缺失／融合手指、面孔和肢体断裂、关节不合理、持物手拓扑改变。至少结合连续可见帧排除模糊、遮挡、透视和运动；不能从一张低清单帧强判六指。

### V2 动作、接触与空间相互作用

触物悬空、手穿物体、脚滑／不着地、动作路径跳断、握持与物体受力明显冲突。幻想漂浮可以成立；漂浮时可见吊具是另一项制作残留。物理原则要结合风格，而非把魔法本身当错。

### V3 对象持续性与因果

连续动作中道具凭空消失／重现、数量变化、接触断开、遮挡后变成另一物体。先确认无cut、合理出框／交接／遮挡，不因没看见整条运动路径就断言消失。对比相邻前后帧并标最小区间。

### V4 人物、衣着与环境的时间一致性

连续镜头中脸、衣纹、材质或背景结构不合理漂移；跨镜头只有已建立同一人／同一事件且没有换装／时间跳跃解释时才强判。正常灯光变色、风格化颜色渐变、明确变形转场须作为替代解释。

### V5 字幕与场内文字

分开记录：字幕转写内容错误、显示起止错误、场内文字错字／乱码／笔画不稳定。字幕必须和实际可听声音比对；字幕系统性错误可以是一类根因，但每处不同实例都留时间和证据。不能把正常外语、不承载意义的装饰或虚焦小字当乱码。

### V6 剪辑、技术与制作残留

非意图性的黑帧、花屏、冻结、重复／跳帧、硬拼断续、明显未清理的UI／吊线等。需要源片原样证据；低码率、标注用转码、切段边界、播放器加载失败都不是生成缺陷。正常停格、闪白、快速蒙太奇、音乐尾奏不自动扣分。

### V7 跨镜头空间与事件关系

已经建立的同一动作／物体／场景关系突然不可能衔接；区分穿帮与正常省略剪辑、象征蒙太奇、梦境和回忆。须引用前后两个位置，不从12秒片段编整片剧情。

### A1 可听的技术异常

突兀断音、爆音、非意图性重复或剪接、与画面事件无关的异常声，仅记录实际听到的时刻。没有独立原曲母带，不把歌手唱法、原曲配器或源曲混音归因于MV生成；没有拟音委托，不要求画面每个动作都必须有音效。

## 标注与核验规则

- 先逐窗口细标，AV与视觉两视角独立；每项写criterion_id、音／画事实、需要修改的命题、最强正常解释、源时间和最小复核区间。
- 再用全片概览＋完整音轨独立检查AV5/AV6/V4/V7，建立跨窗证据；细节不得只凭概览强判。
- 合并重叠窗里同一次事件，保留不同位置的实例；不能因都属“生成错误”而合并。事件实例与问题根因分层存储，不按每帧／每个错字刷分。
- 每条命题经3个新会话直接回原片短段核验，至少2票明确接受才成为GT；uncertain保留诊断，不进漏报分母。
- 纯视觉问题不能冒充音画联合问题；统计二者分布。正文不得把原曲已存在的缺点写成生成过程造成。
- 四支素材先用统一协议构造、冻结，再独立Sol/xhigh开发测试。筛选基于确认问题数量、音画覆盖和开发得分，选材偏差如实记录；不叫独立泛化验证。

本检查表是对上述研究的任务化改编，不宣称采用其官方完整评分实现。

import argparse,json,subprocess,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--model',choices=['music','omni'],required=True);p.add_argument('--input',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--prompt',required=True);p.add_argument('--video',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--fps',type=float,default=2);p.add_argument('--max-pixels',type=int,default=448*448);p.add_argument('--max-tokens',type=int,default=384);p.add_argument('--decode-only',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args()
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoProcessor
    path=a.input.resolve();started=time.monotonic();torch.set_num_threads(min(8,torch.get_num_threads()))
    if a.model=='music':
        from transformers import AudioFlamingo3ForConditionalGeneration
        model_id='nvidia/music-flamingo-hf'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='music-local-') as d:
            wav=Path(d)/'audio.wav';subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-y','-i',str(path),'-vn','-ac','1','-ar','16000',str(wav)],check=True)
            processor=AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(model_id)
            messages=[dict(role='user',content=[dict(type='text',text=a.prompt),dict(type='audio',path=str(wav))])]
            batch=processor.apply_chat_template(messages,tokenize=True,add_generation_prompt=True,return_dict=True)
            if a.decode_only:print(json.dumps(dict(model=model_id,input_shapes={k:list(v.shape) for k,v in batch.items() if hasattr(v,'shape')},decode_only=True)));return
            model=AudioFlamingo3ForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(model_id,torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,device_map='cpu',low_cpu_mem_usage=True,attn_implementation='sdpa').eval()
            batch=batch.to(model.device).to(model.dtype)
            with torch.inference_mode():out=model.generate(**batch,max_new_tokens=a.max_tokens,do_sample=False)
            text=processor.batch_decode(out[:,batch['input_ids'].shape[1]:],skip_special_tokens=True)[0]
    else:
        from transformers import Qwen2_5OmniForConditionalGeneration,Qwen2_5OmniProcessor
        from qwen_omni_utils import process_mm_info
        from qwen_omni_utils.v2_5 import vision_process as vp
        import cv2,numpy as np
        # Avoid torchvision/PyAV metadata_errors incompatibility. Honor caller fps;
        # this is an optional default sampling choice, not a benchmark frame cap.
        def opencv_reader(ele):
            cap=cv2.VideoCapture(ele['video']);fps=cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS);count=int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT));assert fps>0 and count>0
            begin=int(float(ele.get('video_start',0))*fps);end=min(count,int(float(ele.get('video_end',count/fps))*fps));total=end-begin
            n=vp.smart_nframes(ele,total_frames=total,video_fps=fps);indices=torch.linspace(0,total-1,n).round().long();frames=[]
            for idx in indices:
                cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES,begin+int(idx));ok,frame=cap.read();assert ok

{
  "content": """"Shot-boundary detection + per-frame motion/scene stats. Pure measurement, no labels."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def hist(frame):
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    parts = []
    for ch, bins, rng in ((0, 50, 180), (1, 60, 256), (2, 60, 256)):
        h = cv2.calcHist([hsv], [ch], None, [bins], [0, rng]).ravel()
        parts.append(h / (h.sum() + 1e-9))
    return np.concatenate(parts)


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    scale = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0.5
    path = str(ROOT / "media" / f"{name}.mp4")
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(path)
    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
    total = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
    prev_small = None
    prev_gray = None
    diff = []
    mot = []
    bright = []
    idx = 0
    while True:
        ok, frame = cap.read()
        if not ok:
            break
        small = cv2.resize(frame, None, fx=scale, fy=scale, interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
        d = cv2.absdiff(hist(small), hist(prev_small)) if prev_small is not None else 0.0
        diff.append(float(d))
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(small, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        if prev_gray is not None:
            mot.append(float(np.abs(gray.astype(np.int16) - prev_gray.astype(np.int16)).mean()))
        else:
            mot.append(0.0)
        prev_gray = gray
        bright.append(float(gray.mean()))
        prev_small = small
        idx += 1
    cap.release()
    diff = np.array(diff)
    mot = np.array(mot)
    thr = max(0.35, float(np.median(diff) + 6.0 * (np.median(np.abs(diff - np.median(diff))) + 1e-6)))
    cuts = [i for i in range(1, len(diff)) if diff[i] > thr]
    # merge cuts closer than 3 frames
    merged = []
    for c in cuts:
        if merged and c - merged[-1] <= 3:
            if diff[c] > diff[merged[-1]]:
                merged[-1] = c
        else:
            merged.append(c)
    doc = dict(
        source=name,
        fps=fps,
        frames=idx,
        thr=round(thr, 4),
        cut_frames=merged,
        cut_times=[round(c / fps, 3) for c in merged],
        cut_strength=[round(float(diff[c]), 4) for c in merged],
        mean_motion=round(float(mot.mean()), 3),
        motion_by_frame=[round(float(x), 3) for x in mot],
        brightness_by_frame=[round(float(x), 2) for x in bright],
    )
    dst = ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{name}.json"
    dst.write_text(json.dumps(doc), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{name}: frames={idx} fps={fps:.3f} cuts={len(merged)} thr={thr:.3f}")
    print("first 40 cut times:", [round(c / fps, 2) for c in merged[:40]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{
  "content": """"Music-level measurements: tempo/beat grid, onset envelope, RMS, spectral flux, key-ish cues."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    import librosa

    name = sys.argv[1]
    hop = 512
    y, sr = librosa.load(str(ROOT / "media" / f"{name}.mp4"), sr=22050, mono=True)
    dur = len(y) / sr
    tempo, beats = librosa.beat.beat_track(y=y, sr=sr, hop_length=hop, trim=False)
    beat_times = librosa.frames_to_time(beats, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    onset_env = librosa.onset.onset_strength(y=y, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    onsets = librosa.onset.onset_detect(onset_envelope=onset_env, sr=sr, hop_length=hop, backtrack=True)
    onset_times = librosa.frames_to_time(onsets, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    rms = librosa.feature.rms(y=y, hop_length=hop)[0]
    rms_t = librosa.times_like(rms, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    cent = librosa.feature.spectral_centroid(y=y, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)[0]
    flat = librosa.feature.spectral_flatness(y=y, hop_length=hop)[0]
    rolloff = librosa.feature.spectral_rolloff(y=y, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)[0]
    chroma = librosa.feature.chroma_cqt(y=y, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    mfcc = librosa.feature.mfcc(y=y, sr=sr, n_mfcc=13, hop_length=hop)
    ctmp = librosa.times_like(chroma[0], sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    # segment structure via self-similarity agglomerative
    try:
        bounds = librosa.segment.agglomerative(librosa.feature.melspectrogram(y=y, sr=sr, hop_length=hop).astype(np.float32), 12)
        seg_t = librosa.frames_to_time(bounds, sr=sr, hop_length=hop)
    except Exception as e:
        seg_t = []
    tempo_val = float(np.atleast_1d(tempo)[0])
    ib = np.diff(beat_times)
    doc = dict(
        source=name, duration_s=round(dur, 3), sr=sr, hop=hop,
        global_tempo_bpm=round(tempo_val, 2),
        median_ioi_s=round(float(np.median(ib)), 4) if len(ib) else None,
        beats_per_min_from_ioi=round(60.0 / float(np.median(ib)), 2) if len(ib) else None,
        beat_times=[round(float(t), 3) for t in beat_times],
        onset_times=[round(float(t), 3) for t in onset_times],
        onset_rate_per_s=round(len(onset_times) / dur, 3),
        section_boundaries_s=[round(float(t), 2) for t in seg_t],
        rms_t=[round(float(t), 2) for t in rms_t],
        rms=[round(float(v), 5) for v in rms],
        centroid=[round(float(v), 1) for v in cent],
        flatness=[round(float(v), 5) for v in flat],
        rolloff=[round(float(v), 1) for v in rolloff],
        chroma_mean={["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"][i]: round(float(chroma[i].mean()), 4) for i in range(12)},
        chroma_t=[round(float(t), 2) for t in ctmp],
        mfcc_std=[round(float(v), 3) for v in mfcc.std(axis=1)],
    )
    dst = ROOT / "work" / f"music_{name}.json"
    dst.write_text(json.dumps(doc), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{name}: dur={dur:.2f}s tempo={tempo_val:.2f}bpm beats={len(beat_times)} onsets={len(onset_times)} rate={doc['onset_rate_per_s']}/s")
    print("sections:", doc["section_boundaries_s"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{
  "content": """"Build labelled contact sheets from source frames. Geometry only, no interpretation."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = {"uptown": "media/mv_uptown.mp4", "lazy": "media/mv_lazy.mp4"}


def grab(cap, t, fps):
    cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, int(round(t * fps)))
    ok, frame = cap.read()
    return frame if ok else None


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--src", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--start", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--step", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--count", type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--cols", type=int, default=4)
    p.add_argument("--cell", type=int, default=320)
    p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--crop", default=None, help="x:y:w:h in normalized coords, e.g. 0:0.75:1:0.25")
    a = p.parse_args()

    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT / SRC[a.src]))
    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
    cells = []
    for i in range(a.count):
        t = a.start + i * a.step
        f = grab(cap, t, fps)
        if f is None:
            continue
        if a.crop:
            x, y, w, h = [float(v) for v in a.crop.split(":")]
            H, W = f.shape[:2]
            x0, y0 = int(x * W), int(y * H)
            x1, y1 = int((x + w) * W), int((y + h) * H)
            f = f[y0:y1, x0:x1]
        h, w = f.shape[:2]
        sc = a.cell / w
        f = cv2.resize(f, (a.cell, max(1, int(round(h * sc)))), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
        lab = np.zeros((22, f.shape[1], 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        cv2.putText(lab, f"{a.src} {t:.2f}s", (3, 16), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.45, (255, 255, 255), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
        cells.append(np.vstack([lab, f]))
    cap.release()

    cols = a.cols
    rows = (len(cells) + cols - 1) // cols
    cw = max(c.shape[1] for c in cells)
    ch = max(c.shape[0] for c in cells)
    grid = np.full((rows * ch, cols * cw, 3), 40, dtype=np.uint8)
    for i, c in enumerate(cells):
        r, k = divmod(i, cols)
        grid[r * ch:r * ch + c.shape[0], k * cw:k * cw + c.shape[1]] = c
    dst = Path(a.out) if Path(a.out).is_absolute() else ROOT / a.out
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cv2.imwrite(str(dst), grid, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 92] if dst.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg") else [])
    print(dst, grid.shape)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{
  "content": """"Cut review clips (slightly overlapping) for direct AV perception. Geometry only."""
import subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SPEC = {
    "uptown": dict(src="media/mv_uptown.mp4", dur=270.459, width=640, fps=12),
    "lazy": dict(src="media/mv_lazy.mp4", dur=191.821, width=640, fps=12),
}
SEG, OVERLAP = 25.0, 5.0


def main():
    only = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
    outdir = ROOT / "work" / "clips"
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, cfg in SPEC.items():
        if only and only != name:
            continue
        starts = []
        t = 0.0
        while t < cfg["dur"]:
            starts.append(t)
            t += SEG - OVERLAP
        for s in starts:
            e = min(s + SEG, cfg["dur"])
            if e - s < 4.0:
                continue
            dst = outdir / f"{name}_{int(round(s)):03d}-{int(round(e)):03d}.mp4"
            if dst.exists() and dst.stat().st_size > 10000:
                print("skip", dst.name, flush=True)
                continue
            subprocess.run(
                ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                 "-ss", f"{s:.3f}", "-t", f"{e - s:.3f}", "-i", str(ROOT / cfg["src"]),
                 "-vf", "scale={0}:-2,fps={1}".format(cfg["width"], cfg["fps"]),
                 "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "26", "-preset", "veryfast",
                 "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "96k", "-ac", "2", str(dst)],
                check=True,
            )
            print("made", dst.name, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{
  "content": """"Summarise shot structure from shots_*.json (measurement only)."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DUR = {"mv_uptown": 270.459, "mv_lazy": 191.821}


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    d = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{name}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    fps = d["fps"]
    times = d["cut_times"]
    strength = d["cut_strength"]
    # drop the very first frame fade-in
    pairs = [(t, s) for t, s in zip(times, strength) if t > 0.2]
    bounds = [0.0] + [t for t, _ in pairs] + [DUR[name]]
    print(f"== {name}  fps={fps}  detected cuts={len(pairs)}")
    prev = None
    for i in range(len(bounds) - 1):
        a, b = bounds[i], bounds[i + 1]
        dur = b - a
        g = ""
        if abs(a / 5.0 - round(a / 5.0)) < 0.04:
            g = "  (on 5.0s grid)"
        print(f"shot {i:3d}: {a:8.3f} -> {b:8.3f}  len={dur:7.3f}{g}")
    lens = np.diff(bounds)
    print("shot lengths:", [round(float(x), 2) for x in lens])
    print("median len", round(float(np.median(lens)), 2), "mean", round(float(np.mean(lens)), 2))
    # off-grid cuts
    off = [t for t, _ in pairs if abs(t / 5.0 - round(t / 5.0)) >= 0.04]
    print("off-5s-grid cuts:", [round(x, 3) for x in off])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  "content": """"Find visually repeated spans by matching downsampled frame signatures across time."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = {"uptown": "media/mv_uptown.mp4", "lazy": "media/mv_lazy.mp4"}


def sig(frame):
    g = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(frame, (16, 16)), cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
    g -= g.mean()
    return g / (np.linalg.norm(g) + 1e-9)


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    fps_sample = 6.0
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT / SRC[name]))
    src_fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
    step = max(1, int(round(src_fps / fps_sample)))
    sigs, times = [], []
    i = 0
    while True:
        ok, frame = cap.read()
        if not ok:
            break
        if i % step == 0:
            sigs.append(sig(frame))
            times.append(i / src_fps)
        i += 1
    cap.release()
    S = np.stack(sigs)
    T = np.array(times)
    M = S @ S.T  # cosine similarity
    hits = []
    n = len(T)
    min_gap = int(4.0 * fps_sample)  # only non-adjacent repeats
    for a in range(n):
        for b in range(a + min_gap, n):
            if M[a, b] > 0.955:
                hits.append((round(float(T[a]), 2), round(float(T[b]), 2), round(float(M[a, b]), 4)))
    # compress consecutive matches into spans
    spans = []
    for a, b, s in hits:
        if spans and abs(a - spans[-1][1] - 1 / fps_sample) < 0.3 and abs(b - spans[-1][3] - 1 / fps_sample) < 0.3:
            spans[-1][1] = a
            spans[-1][3] = b
            spans[-1][4] += 1
            spans[-1][5] = max(spans[-1][5], s)
        else:
            spans.append([a, a, b, b, 1, s])
    out = [dict(t0=round(x[0], 2), t1=round(x[1], 2), u0=round(x[2], 2), u1=round(x[3], 2),
                frames=x[4], sim=round(x[5], 4)) for x in spans if x[4] >= 3]
    dst = ROOT / "work" / f"repeat_{name}.json"
    dst.write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=name, min_gap_s=min_gap / fps_sample, spans=out, raw=len(hits)), indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{name}: sampled {n} frames, raw matches {len(hits)}, spans>=3 frames: {len(out)}")
    for x in out:
        print(f"  {x['t0']:7.2f}-{x['t1']:7.2f}  <->  {x['u0']:7.2f}-{x['u1']:7.2f}   frames={x['frames']:3d} sim={x['sim']:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

}

  "content": """"Compare whole shots pairwise for verbatim repeated footage."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = {"uptown": "media/mv_uptown.mp4", "lazy": "media/mv_lazy.mp4"}
DUR = {"uptown": 270.459, "lazy": 191.821}


def sig(frame):
    g = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(frame, (16, 16)), cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32).ravel()
    g -= g.mean()
    return g / (np.linalg.norm(g) + 1e-9)


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    d = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{name.replace('_', '_')}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) \
        if (ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{name}.json").exists() else None
    key = name if f"shots_{name}.json" in [p.name for p in (ROOT / "work").iterdir()] else f"mv_{name}"
    d = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{key}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    fps = d["fps"]
    cuts = [t for t in d["cut_times"] if t > 0.2]
    bounds = [0.0] + cuts + [DUR[name]]
    shots = [(bounds[i], bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1) if bounds[i + 1] - bounds[i] >= 1.0]

    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT / SRC[name]))
    cache = {}

    def frames_in(a, b, step_s=1 / 6):
        out = []
        t = a + 0.15
        while t < b - 0.1:
            fi = int(round(t * fps))
            if fi not in cache:
                cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, fi)
                ok, fr = cap.read()
                cache[fi] = sig(fr) if ok else None
            s = cache[fi]
            if s is not None:
                out.append((t, s))
            t += step_s
        return out

    feats = []
    for a, b in shots:
        fs = frames_in(a, b)
        if fs:
            feats.append((a, b, np.stack([f[1] for f in fs]), [f[0] for f in fs]))
    cap.release()

    print(f"{name}: {len(shots)} usable shots")
    rep = []
    for i in range(len(feats)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(feats)):

            n = min(len(Si), len(Sj))
            if n < 4:

            m = float((Si[:n] * Sj[:n]).sum(1).mean())
            if m > 0.90:

    rep.sort(key=lambda r: -r[5])
    for r in rep:

    (ROOT / "work" / f"shotdup_{name}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(dict(source=name, shots=[[round(a, 3), round(b, 3)] for a, b in shots], repeats=rep), indent=1),
        encoding="utf-8")

{
  "content": """"Locate the exact extent of frame-identical footage reuse between two time ranges."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def sig(frame):
    g = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(frame, (24, 24)), cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32).ravel()
    g -= g.mean()
    return g / (np.linalg.norm(g) + 1e-9)


def main():
    src = sys.argv[1]
    a0, a1 = float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3])
    b0 = float(sys.argv[4])
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT / src))
    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)

    def get(fi):
        cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, fi)
        ok, fr = cap.read()
        return sig(fr) if ok else None

    fa, fb = int(a0 * fps), int(a1 * fps)
    best = None
    for shift_frames in range(int((a0 - 5) * fps), int((a0 + 5) * fps)):
        sims = []
        for fi in range(fa, fb, 2):
            sa, sb = get(fi), get(fi + shift_frames)
            if sa is None or sb is None:
                continue
            sims.append(float((sa * sb).sum()))
        if not sims:
            continue
        m = float(np.mean(sims))
        if best is None or m > best[1]:
            best = (shift_frames, m, len(sims))
    shift_frames, m, n = best
    print(f"best shift = {shift_frames} frames = {shift_frames/fps:.3f}s  meanSim={m:.4f} over {n} samples")
    if m < 0.9:
        cap.release()
        return
    # walk forward/backward at frame granularity to find exact span
    lo = fa
    while lo > 0:
        sa, sb = get(lo - 1), get(lo - 1 + shift_frames)
        if sa is None or sb is None or float((sa * sb).sum()) < 0.90:
            break
        lo -= 1
    hi = fb
    while True:
        sa, sb = get(hi), get(hi + shift_frames)
        if sa is None or sb is None or float((sa * sb).sum()) < 0.90:
            break
        hi += 1
    print(f"duplicated span A: {lo/fps:.3f}s .. {(hi-1)/fps:.3f}s  ({(hi-lo)/fps:.3f}s)")
    print(f"duplicated span B: {(lo+shift_frames)/fps:.3f}s .. {(hi-1+shift_frames)/fps:.3f}s")
    cap.release()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json, sys

}


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    d = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / CFG[name]["shots"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    m = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / CFG[name]["music"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    a = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / CFG[name]["asr"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    beats = np.array(m["beat_times"])
    bar = 4.0
    bar_lines = beats[::int(bar)] if len(beats) > 4 else beats
    # build a regular bar grid from the first beat
    b0 = beats[0]
    ioi = m["median_ioi_s"]
    beat_period = ioi
    grid = np.arange(b0, m["duration_s"], beat_period * 4)

    words = []
    for s in a["segments"]:
        for w in s["words"]:
            words.append((w[0], w[1], w[2].strip()))

    print(f"== {name}: {len(cuts)} cuts, beat={beat_period:.4f}s bar={beat_period*4:.4f}s")
    off_bar, mid_word = [], []
    for t in cuts:
        k = np.argmin(np.abs(grid - t))
        delta = t - grid[k]
        off_bar.append(delta)
        hit = [(ws, we, wd) for ws, we, wd in words if ws < t < we]

    W, H = int(cap.get(3)), int(cap.get(4))
    # bottom band where captions live
    y0, y1 = int(H * 0.86), int(H * 0.985)
    step = 2
    t, vals = 0.0, []
    i = 0
    while True:

        if not ok:

        if i % step == 0:
            band = cv2.cvtColor(f[y0:y1, :], cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            # bright text on dark outline: count pixels above 200 and their row spread
            mask = (band > 205).astype(np.uint8)
            rows = mask.sum(axis=1)
            vals.append((i / fps, int(mask.sum()), int(rows.max()) if len(rows) else 0))

import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CFG = {
    "uptown": dict(src="media/mv_uptown.mp4", out="subs_uptown.json"),
    "lazy": dict(src="media/mv_lazy.mp4", out="subs_lazy.json"),
}


def band_sig(f, H):
    y0, y1 = int(H * 0.855), int(H * 0.99)
    band = cv2.cvtColor(f[y0:y1, :], cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    m = (band > 200).astype(np.float32)
    if m.sum() < 120:
        return None, 0
    small = cv2.resize(m, (96, 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).ravel()
    small -= small.mean()
    return small / (np.linalg.norm(small) + 1e-9), int(m.sum())


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    cfg = CFG[name]
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT / cfg["src"]))
    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
    W, H = int(cap.get(3)), int(cap.get(4))
    step = max(1, int(round(fps / 10.0)))  # 10 Hz
    samples = []
    i = 0
    while True:
        ok, f = cap.read()
        if not ok:
            break
        if i % step == 0:
            s, n = band_sig(f, H)
            samples.append((i / fps, s, n))
        i += 1
    cap.release()

    segs = []
    cur = None
    for k, (t, s, n) in enumerate(samples):
        if s is None:
            if cur is not None:
                if t - cur["t0"] >= 0.25:
                    segs.append(cur)
                cur = None
            continue
        if cur is None:
            cur = dict(t0=t, t1=t, sig=s, rep=t, nmax=n)
            continue
        sim = float((cur["sig"] * s).sum())
        if sim < 0.90:
            segs.append(cur)
            cur = dict(t0=t, t1=t, sig=s, rep=t, nmax=n)
        else:
            cur["t1"] = t
            cur["nmax"] = max(cur["nmax"], n)
    if cur is not None:
        segs.append(cur)

    out = [dict(start=round(s["t0"], 2), end=round(s["t1"] + 1 / 10, 2),
                mid=round((s["t0"] + s["t1"]) / 2, 2), len=round(s["t1"] - s["t0"], 2))
           for s in segs if s["t1"] - s["t0"] >= 0.25]
    (ROOT / "work" / cfg["out"]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=name, n=len(out), captions=out), indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{name}: {len(out)} caption events")
    for c in out:
        print(f"  {c['start']:7.2f} -> {c['end']:7.2f}  len={c['len']:5.2f}  read@{c['mid']:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":

  "content": """"Re-threshold stored per-frame histogram diffs to recover missed cuts, and report the shot grid."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DUR = {"mv_uptown": 270.459, "mv_lazy": 191.821}


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    thr = float(sys.argv[2])
    d = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{name}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    fps = d["fps"]
    diff = np.array(d["diff_by_frame"])
    cuts = [i for i in range(1, len(diff)) if diff[i] > thr]
    merged = []
    for c in cuts:
        if merged and c - merged[-1] <= 4:
            if diff[c] > diff[merged[-1]]:
                merged[-1] = c
        else:
            merged.append(c)
    times = [round(c / fps, 3) for c in merged]
    bounds = [0.0] + times + [DUR[name]]
    lens = [round(bounds[i + 1] - bounds[i], 3) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]
    print(f"{name}: thr={thr} cuts={len(times)}")
    print("cut times:", times)
    print("shot lens:", lens)
    ints = [abs(l - round(l)) for l in lens]
    print(f"lens within 0.05s of an integer: {sum(1 for x in ints if x < 0.05)}/{len(lens)}")
    fives = [abs(b / 5.0 - round(b / 5.0)) for b in bounds[:-1]]
    print(f"boundaries within 0.05s of a 5s multiple: {sum(1 for x in fives if x < 0.05)}/{len(fives)}")
    (ROOT / "work" / f"shots_{name}_thr{int(thr*100)}.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        dict(source=name, thr=thr, cut_times=times, lens=lens), indent=1), encoding="utf-8")

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    wav = sys.argv[1]
    a0, a1, b0 = float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), float(sys.argv[4])
    y, sr = sf.read(str(ROOT / "work" / "audio" / wav), dtype="float32")
    if y.ndim > 1:
        y = y.mean(axis=1)
    A = y[int(a0 * sr):int(a1 * sr)]
    shift = int(round((b0 - a0) * sr))
    B = y[int(b0 * sr):int(b0 * sr) + len(A)]
    n = min(len(A), len(B))
    A, B = A[:n], B[:n]
    corr = float((A * B).sum() / (np.sqrt((A * A).sum()) * np.sqrt((B * B).sum()) + 1e-12))
    # also compare loudness envelopes at 50 ms
    k = int(0.05 * sr)
    ea = np.array([A[i:i + k].std() for i in range(0, n - k, k)])
    eb = np.array([B[i:i + k].std() for i in range(0, n - k, k)])
    m = min(len(ea), len(eb))
    ec = float((ea[:m] * eb[:m]).sum() / (np.linalg.norm(ea[:m]) * np.linalg.norm(eb[:m]) + 1e-12))
    print(f"{wav}: {a0}-{a1}s vs {b0}-{b0 + (a1 - a0):.2f}s")
    print(f"  sample-level Pearson r = {corr:.4f}")
    print(f"  50ms loudness-envelope r = {ec:.4f}")
    print(f"  rms A={float(A.std()):.4f}  rms B={float(B.std()):.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{
  "content": """"Per-shot letterbox/pillarbox geometry: measure black margins across the whole video."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CFG = {
    "uptown": dict(src="media/mv_uptown.mp4", shots="shots_mv_uptown_thr25.json", out="bars_uptown.json"),
    "lazy": dict(src="media/mv_lazy.mp4", shots="shots_mv_lazy_thr13.json", out="bars_lazy.json"),
}


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1]
    cfg = CFG[name]
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT / cfg["src"]))
    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
    W, H = int(cap.get(3)), int(cap.get(4))
    step = max(1, int(round(fps / 4)))
    rows = []
    i = 0
    while True:
        ok, f = cap.read()
        if not ok:
            break
        if i % step == 0:
            g = cv2.cvtColor(f, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            colmax = g.max(axis=0)
            nz = np.nonzero(colmax > 24)[0]
            left = int(nz[0]) if len(nz) else W // 2
            right = int(nz[-1]) if len(nz) else W // 2
            rowmax = g.max(axis=1)
            nzr = np.nonzero(rowmax > 24)[0]
            top = int(nzr[0]) if len(nzr) else 0
            bot = int(nzr[-1]) if len(nzr) else H - 1
            rows.append([round(i / fps, 3), left, right, top, bot])
        i += 1
    cap.release()
    d = json.loads((ROOT / "work" / cfg["shots"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    bounds = [0.0] + [t for t in d["cut_times"] if t > 0.2] + [d["cut_times"][-1] if d["cut_times"] else 0]
    arr = np.array(rows)
    T = arr[:, 0]
    print(f"{name}: {W}x{H}  full-frame AR={W/H:.3f}")
    out = []
    for k in range(len(bounds) - 1):
        a, b = bounds[k], bounds[k + 1]
        m = (T >= a) & (T < b)
        if m.sum() < 2:
            continue
        seg = arr[m]
        left = int(np.median(seg[:, 1])); right = int(np.median(seg[:, 2]))
        top = int(np.median(seg[:, 3])); bot = int(np.median(seg[:, 4]))
        w = right - left + 1; h = bot - top + 1
        out.append(dict(start=round(a, 2), end=round(b, 2), left=left, right=right, top=top, bottom=bot,
                        content_w=w, content_h=h, content_ar=round(w / h, 3),
                        pillar=left + (W - 1 - right), letterbox=top + (H - 1 - bot)))
    for o in out:
        tag = ""
        if o["pillar"] > 8:
            tag = f"  PILLARBOX {o['pillar']}px"
        if o["letterbox"] > 8:
            tag += f"  LETTERBOX {o['letterbox']}px"
        print(f"  {o['start']:7.2f}-{o['end']:7.2f}  content {o['content_w']}x{o['content_h']} AR={o['content_ar']:.3f}{tag}")
    (ROOT / "work" / cfg["out"]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=name, W=W, H=H, shots=out), indent=1), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

}

{
  "content": """"Stack two sets of labelled frames side by side for visual comparison."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    a_files = sys.argv[1].split(",")
    b_files = sys.argv[2].split(",")
    out = sys.argv[3]
    w = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 460
    rows = []
    for fa, fb in zip(a_files, b_files):
        ims = []
        for f, lab in ((fa, "A"), (fb, "B")):
            img = cv2.imread(str(ROOT / f))
            H, W = img.shape[:2]
            sc = w / W
            img = cv2.resize(img, (w, int(H * sc)), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
            bar = np.zeros((20, w, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
            cv2.putText(bar, Path(f).stem, (3, 15), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.45, (0, 255, 255), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
            ims.append(np.vstack([bar, img]))
        h = max(i.shape[0] for i in ims)
        pad = [np.zeros((h, i.shape[1], 3), dtype=np.uint8) for i in ims]
        for i, p in enumerate(pad):
            p[:ims[i].shape[0]] = ims[i]
        rows.append(np.hstack([pad[0], np.zeros((h, 6, 3), dtype=np.uint8), pad[1]]))
    grid = np.vstack(rows)
    dst = ROOT / out
    cv2.imwrite(str(dst), grid)
    print(dst, grid.shape)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
